content.body: Resilia is powered by oil of oregano and cold-pressed black seed oil — two of nature's most time-tested botanicals. Our easy-to-swallow softgels feature premium oil of oregano with naturally occurring carvacrol and black seed oil with thymoquinone. Clean, no-BS ingredients, third-party tested, and shipped right from the USA to deliver daily support for a healthy gut, a healthy inflammatory response, and your body's natural defenses. Just two softgels a day, no powders or routines to remember.
